biggest_catch: There is no annual fee, so year-one net math is the full bonus: up to 40,000 United miles (30,000 from the spend + 10,000 for the authorized user), worth roughly $440-$540 in United travel value at typical mile valuations — as long as you actually fly United or its partners; miles you never use are worth $0.
catches: Only claim a bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend that money — never spend $1,000 extra just to chase 30,000 miles; only purchases count, not cash advances.
No annual fee means the fee can't eat the bonus — year-one net is the full up-to-40,000 miles minus $0, IF you redeem them on United/partner travel.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry on your credit report.
Carrying a balance at the card's 19.74%-28.24% variable APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay the statement balance in full every month.
The extra 10,000 miles require adding an authorized user within the first 3 months your account is open — their spending lands on your bill, so only add someone you fully trust.

Bonus eligibility: 'This card product is available to you if you do not have this card and have not received a new Cardmember bonus for this card in the past 24 months.' Chase's 5/24 application policy also applies.

steps: Go to the official Chase page https://creditcards.chase.com/travel-credit-cards/united/united-gateway and confirm the current new-cardmember offer before applying.
Apply online and get approved (expect a hard credit inquiry).
Within the first 3 months your account is open, spend $1,000 on purchases you were ALREADY going to make — groceries, gas, transit. Do not spend extra to chase it.
Optional: add an authorized user within the first 3 months to earn the extra 10,000 bonus miles (total up to 40,000); their charges hit your bill, so only add someone you trust.
Pay the statement balance in full every month — the 0% intro APR is on purchases only for 12 months, then 19.74%-28.24%; a carried balance at those rates eats the bonus.
Watch your MileagePlus account after you qualify; miles post after qualifying purchases — allow up to 8 weeks, then call if missing.
timing: Not stated on the captured official page; Chase credits the bonus to your MileagePlus account after qualifying purchases — allow up to 8 weeks. Confirm the window on your own offer confirmation.
